::: {.callout-note title="Setup"}
This simulator requires the [shinylive Quarto extension](https://quarto-ext.github.io/shinylive/). Install it in your project:

```sh
quarto add quarto-ext/shinylive
```

The app source lives in `market-simulator-app/` and can be run as a standalone Shiny app with `shiny::runApp("market-simulator-app/")`. 

Shinylive doesn't have access to your local or server filesystem for security reasons, so you have to [do some tricky shenanigans to get files loaded](https://quarto-ext.github.io/shinylive/load_file.html), like embedding files as text (either as a CSV or as a binary file), or fetching them via HTTP.

Here, I opted for binary embedding since the `.rds` model object from {mclogit} doesn't really work as plain text. {mclogit} includes a ton of extra information in its model objects, and the resulting `.rds` file is like ≈350 KB, and there's no nice way to stick *that* in here as plain text, so I stripped it down and removed a bunch of data from the different slots in the object. What remains is something that's only 1.6 KB (!), but it still works with {marginaleffects}!

The code for shrinking the model and saving it as `.rds` is in `market-simulator-app/_shrink_model.R`. It outputs plain text base64 binary output that you can paste down in the `## file: model.rds` block below.
:::

```{shinylive-r}
#| standalone: true
#| viewerHeight: 950

## file: global.R
{{< include market-simulator-app/global.R >}}

## file: ui.R
{{< include market-simulator-app/ui.R >}}

## file: server.R
{{< include market-simulator-app/server.R >}}

## file: model.rds
## type: binary

```
